Post 1/6:
🚨 Claude Fable 5 is about to replace manual traders on Polymarket
My current arb bot (built with Claude) is already running and made +$5,474 in just a few days — starting from $100 publicly.
It never predicted a single candle.
Post 2/6:
The strategy is dead simple:
Only trade when YES + NO < $1 on BTC Up/Down markets.
One side resolves to $1, the other to $0.
When the orderbook is messy, you can buy both sides for 96 cents and lock in a guaranteed 4-cent profit — no matter where Bitcoin goes.
Post 3/6:
The entire game is speed.
Gaps close in seconds. Fees eat the thin ones. You need both legs filled before the opportunity disappears.
This is where a better model actually changes everything for builders.
Post 4/6:
Fable 5 writes tighter execution code, reduces lag between spotting the gap and firing both legs, catches edge cases better, and backtests/debugs much faster.
The gap between people who just click buttons and people who build real systems is about to get even wider.
Post 5/6:
Most traders are still guessing direction.
The real edge in 2026 is building autonomous systems that exploit pure math inefficiencies — 24/7, without emotion.
